tabContent.name: Expand Your UK Fam and WIN BEANS!

textContent.value:
Event Rules:

1.This event is for selected GB/IE Families only.

2.Successfully inviting one user to join the family =10 points; During the event period, invited users MUST still be family members on the last day of the event. If a user leaves the family during the event period, the user will not be count

3.According to the family ranking, Top 3 Families will win beans rewards. (must reach minimum 40 points, If the point is not reached, the reward will be halved after reach 10 points, no rewards if less than 10 points.）

4.Beans rewards will be sent to family leaders
